title: Suri Cruise severs legal ties with father Tom Cruise, adopts Katie Holmes' middle name: Report
content:
• Suri Cruise first drew public attention for using the name Suri Noelle during her graduation from LaGuardia High School in June 2024.
• Tom Cruise and Katie Holmes welcomed Suri in April 2006, married seven months later, and divorced in August 2012.
• Tom Cruise is next set to appear in the film "Digger", scheduled to release on October 2, 2026.

title: Newly released Joe Biden recordings show him referring to classified information: Report
content:
• Audio recordings, totaling around 70 hours, of former US President Joe Biden revealed him discussing classified information with his ghostwriter, Mark Zwonitzer.
• Justice Department Special Counsel Robert Hur presented a report in February 2024 concluding that Joe Biden "willfully retained and disclosed classified materials" after his vice presidency.
• Despite the findings, Special Counsel Robert Hur's report did not recommend prosecuting Joe Biden, stating that the evidence did not establish his guilt beyond a reasonable doubt.

title: Prime Video India signs multi-year CJ ENM deal to bring more than 100 Korean shows to India
content:
• Prime Video India has signed a multi-year distribution deal with South Korean entertainment company CJ ENM to bring more than 100 Korean titles to Indian audiences over the next two years.
• The agreement between Prime Video India and CJ ENM, announced in Mumbai, includes 26 new CJ ENM titles as well as programmes from the studio’s existing content library.
• All new and upcoming titles under the Prime Video India-CJ ENM deal will include English subtitles and dubbing in Hindi, Tamil and Telugu to enhance accessibility.

title: CJP launches legal aid fund website for NEET protesters, Kapil Sibal pledges  ₹1 crore
content:
• Kapil Sibal pledged ₹1 crore to support the legal aid fund launched by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) for NEET protesters.
• The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) called off its 37-day agitation on July 25, reportedly after the government agreed to drop cases and introduce anti-paper leak legislation.
• Kapil Sibal, a senior advocate and Rajya Sabha MP, previously served as the Union Minister of Human Resource Development (HRD) or Education Minister of India from May 2009 to October 2012.

title: Taco Bell customer visits tumble 31% after Cyclospora parasite outbreak tied to lettuce — Report
content:
• Taco Bell's customer visits on July 17 dropped about 31% below the chain's average Friday traffic for the year.
• The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has confirmed over 4,100 laboratory-confirmed Cyclospora infections nationwide since May 1.
• Parent company Yum! Brands' shares have fallen about 6% since July 14, following Taco Bell's announcement of precautionary menu changes.

title: Weak investments, higher oil prices to slow India's GDP growth to 6.6% in FY27: Poll
content:
• India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is forecast to grow 6.6% in the fiscal year ending March 2027, according to a Reuters poll, down from 7.7% in FY2025/26.
• Official data indicated private investment expanded 10.8% in the January-March quarter, marking its fastest pace under the revised GDP series.
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is expected to keep interest rates unchanged at its August policy meeting to assess inflationary impacts of higher energy prices.

title: GST panel may consider allowing transfer of unused tax credit within corporate groups
content:
• A proposal is being considered by the GST fitment committee and the GST Council to allow the transfer of unused Input Tax Credit (ITC) within corporate groups.
• The proposed mechanism seeks to permit the transfer of excess ITC between companies that share common ownership or a common PAN, subject to safeguards.
• The current GST framework often results in inefficient credit utilisation, forcing one group company to pay tax in cash while another holds surplus tax credits.

title: Govt approves RBI's trials of ₹10, ₹20 polymer notes; no plan to replace paper currency
content:
• The government has approved RBI's proposal for field trials of one billion pieces each of ₹10 and ₹20 polymer banknotes, as confirmed by Minister of State for Finance Pankaj Chaudhary.
• There is no proposal to entirely replace paper currency with polymer-based notes.
• The ₹500 note accounts for 86% of the total value of notes in circulation, with the overall value of currency in circulation rising to ₹41.23 lakh crore by the end of March 2026.

title: Centre to release Rs 335 crore to Maharashtra as second instalment under RKVY scheme: Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan
content:
• The Centre is set to release Rs 335 crore to Maharashtra as the second installment under the Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY), as announced by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
• Maharashtra is the first state to become eligible for the second installment of RKVY, having utilized about Rs 260 crore, exceeding the prescribed 75 per cent utilization benchmark of the first installment.
• Under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), both Kisan Credit Card (KCC) and non-KCC farmers are eligible to avail of crop insurance benefits.

title: RBI to hold rates through 2026 as growth risks outweigh inflation: Poll of economists
content:
• The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee is expected to leave the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% at its August 3-5 meeting, following a 25-basis-point reduction to this rate in December.
• India's inflation rose to 4.38% in June, marking the first time it exceeded the RBI's 4% target since January 2025.
• The Indian economy's growth is forecast to slow to 6.6% this fiscal year, a decrease from 7.7% last year.
